mentions.name: Applist
mentions.description: A simple, minimalist app launcher for iPhone that respects user privacy and has no subscription plan. The author also published a companion GitHub catalog of iOS URL schemes and universal links.
mentions.problem: Existing iPhone app launchers weren't simple or minimalist, didn't respect privacy, and came with subscription plans.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I was recently looking for a simple minimalist app launcher for iPhone that would respect my privacy and didn’t come with a stupid subscription plan, so instead I made my own!
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/applist/id6743515756

I also published the list of url schemes / universal links on GitHub: 
http://github.com/sxp-studio/app-list-catalog
